name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (via National Scholarship Portal)
amount: Tuition fee reimbursement plus maintenance allowance, as per central norms (depends on course and hostel status)
documents: Bank account passbook linked to Aadhaar
OTR (One Time Registration) ID from NSP
apply_steps: Open scholarships.gov.in and register or log in with your Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
Create your 14-digit OTR ID if you do not have one.
Choose the Post Matric Scholarship for SC students and fill your personal, academic and bank details.
Upload your documents and submit the form.
Note the application ID. Your institute or school verifies the application later.
Track the status on your NSP dashboard until the amount reaches your bank.
verification_note: Dates from secondary news sources that cite NSP. Not yet checked against the official notice.

name: PM YASASVI Top Class Education Scholarship
provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (via National Scholarship Portal)
amount: Up to ₹1,25,000 per year for Class 11-12 (tuition and hostel). College amounts differ by institute.
documents: Family income certificate (below ₹2.5 lakh per year)
apply_steps: Open scholarships.gov.in and log in or register with your OTR ID.
Select PM YASASVI Top Class Education for OBC, EBC or DNT students.
Fill your academic and bank details and upload the documents.
Submit and save the application ID.
Your college or school verifies the application. Track it on the NSP dashboard.
verification_note: Dates from secondary news sources that cite NSP. School and college dates differ; confirm on the portal.

name: Post Matric Scholarship for ST Students
provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs (via National Scholarship Portal)
amount: As per central norms (tuition and maintenance). Confirm the amount for your course on the portal.
apply_steps: Open scholarships.gov.in and log in or register.
Create your OTR ID if you do not have one.
Select the Post Matric Scholarship for ST students and fill the form.
Upload documents and submit. Save the application ID.
Track verification on the NSP dashboard.
verification_note: Not checked. Dates and amount need confirmation before publishing.

name: Odisha State Post Matric Scholarship
provider: Government of Odisha (Odisha State Scholarship Portal)
amount: To be confirmed on the Odisha portal
apply_steps: Open scholarship.odisha.gov.in and register.
Log in and apply for the Post Matric Scholarship for the current year.
Fill personal, academic and bank details and upload documents.
Submit and save the application number.
Track the status on the portal.
verification_note: Opening for 2026-27 found in a news source; deadline and eligibility not confirmed.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
provider: Ministry of Education (via National Scholarship Portal)
amount: Fixed amount per year, as per scheme norms. Confirm on the portal.
apply_steps: Open scholarships.gov.in and log in with your OTR ID.
Select the Central Sector Scheme for college students.
Fill in your Class 12 result and college details.
Upload documents and submit.
Your college verifies the application.
criteria_note: Class 12 merit rule applies (see scheme guidelines). Not checked in this prototype.
verification_note: Sources disagree on the deadline (30 Sep vs 31 Oct 2026). Merit and income rules not confirmed.

name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
provider: Department of Science & Technology, Government of India
amount: Around ₹80,000 per year for B.Sc. or equivalent (confirm on the portal)
documents: JEE / NEET rank card (if used for eligibility)
Admission proof for a science course
apply_steps: Open online-inspire.gov.in during the application window.
Register and fill the form with your Class 12 details.
Upload documents and submit.
Track the application on the portal.
criteria_note: Top 1% in Class 12 board, or a high JEE/NEET rank, or other merit routes. Students must join a B.Sc. or basic-science course.
verification_note: No confirmed 2026 cycle date. Next cycle is expected early 2027.

name: Pragati Scholarship for Girls (AICTE)
provider: All India Council for Technical Education
amount: Confirm on the AICTE site (scheme has a yearly fixed amount)
documents: Admission proof in an AICTE-approved technical course
apply_steps: Open the AICTE scholarship portal from the official site.
Register and open the Pragati Scholarship form.
Fill your details and upload documents.
Submit and save the application number.
criteria_note: Only for girls in AICTE-approved technical courses (diploma and degree).
verification_note: Not checked. Application window and amount need confirmation.
